# notelocker

> Driving an LNURLcash bearer-note locker over USB means picking apart two
> different framings and two different device families by hand. notelocker is
> a CLI and library that speaks lnurl-vault's serial command set over either
> framing, so one tool drives an lnurl-vault and a heartwood alike.

For anyone scripting or operating a note locker device: minting notes,
listing and spending them, or provisioning LUD-25 seed-recoverable notes.
`--transport auto` works out whether the attached device is framed
(heartwood) or newline-delimited JSON (lnurl-vault) and drives either the
same way, so scripts do not need to know which board is on the end of the
cable.

## Getting Started

```
npx @forgesworn/notelocker info
```

Or install it globally with `npm i -g @forgesworn/notelocker`. It depends on
`serialport`, a native module with prebuilt binaries for current Node on
macOS, Linux and Windows.

```
$ notelocker ports
/dev/cu.usbmodem2101  Espressif (native USB)

$ notelocker list
a1b2c3d4  CONFIRMED  50.000 sat  float      moneyer.dev
```

As a library:

```ts
import {detectTransport, openPort, lookup, timeoutFor} from '@forgesworn/notelocker'

const wire = await openPort('/dev/cu.usbmodem2101')
const transport = await detectTransport(wire)
const spec = lookup('list')
const reply = await transport.request(spec.build([], {}), timeoutFor(spec))
await wire.close()
```

## Key Concepts

- **Transport**: the framing over the wire. `frameTransport` is a heartwood
  (`HW` magic, type, length, payload, CRC32); `lineTransport` is an
  lnurl-vault (one JSON object per line). `detectTransport` probes for
  whichever is attached.
- **CommandSpec**: one entry in `COMMANDS`, describing a protocol command:
  its `cmd` name, whether it is `gated` (needs a physical button press) and
  whether it is `vaultOnly` or `heartwoodOnly`.
- **Gated commands**: commands that put a card on the device's display and
  wait for a physical confirmation, up to 30 seconds. They use
  `GATED_TIMEOUT_MS`; other commands use `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS`.
- **Seed-recoverable notes**: LUD-25 notes derived from a per-mint domain
  node instead of drawn at random, so they survive a board loss if the
  owner still has the seed. Provisioned with `notelocker provision-cash`.

## API Surface

Library exports from `@forgesworn/notelocker`:

- `openPort`, `listPorts`, `candidates`, `choosePort`: find and open a
  device's serial port.
- `detectTransport`, `frameTransport`, `lineTransport`: build a `Transport`
  for a given `Wire`.
- `lookup`, `timeoutFor`, `COMMANDS`: look up a `CommandSpec` by name and
  pick its timeout.
- `FrameDecoder`, `encodeFrame`, `crc32`: the frame codec, pure and
  dependency-free.
- Errors: `TimeoutError`, `DeviceRefusedError`, `TransportError`, `PortError`,
  `UsageError`, `FrameError`.

CLI commands: `ports`, `info`, `list`, `new`, `new-pair`, `confirm`, `import`,
`export`, `spend`, `discard`, `rename`, `delete`, `reset` (lnurl-vault only),
`provision-cash`, `forget-cash`, `list-cash`, `set-cash-index` (heartwood
only), `raw`. Run `notelocker --help` for the full usage.
